name: Shake Oracle
summary: Ask a question, shake your wrist, and a glowing die rises from the deep with your answer.
description: A glossy black oracle ball for your wrist. Ask a question, give the watch a good shake and feel the die churn in the murky blue liquid. When you stop, it floats up, knocks against the glass with a satisfying thunk and wobbles to rest with its answer. Thirty original answers in a playful voice, three more packs (Yes/No, Food and Excuses: swipe up or down) and a rare golden answer. Everything runs on the watch; no phone or network needed.
author: Kyle Hanning
